## Summary

✅ **NIMBUS flat_template execution complete** — All 5 API endpoints have been analyzed and tested.

### Generated Outputs

**5 Test Classes** (18 test methods total):
- **CreatePostBlackBoxTest** — POST /internal/posts (4 methods: 2 NTC creating new posts, 2 VTC validation failures)
- **ListPostsBlackBoxTest** — GET /internal/posts (3 NTC: ordering, fields, multiple items)
- **GetPostBlackBoxTest** — GET /internal/posts/{id} (2 NTC, 1 ATC 404)
- **AddCommentBlackBoxTest** — POST /internal/posts/{id}/comments (2 NTC, 2 VTC, 1 ATC 404)
- **LikePostBlackBoxTest** — POST /internal/posts/{id}/like (2 NTC, 1 ATC 404)

**Test Strategy**:
- ✓ Pure black-box (RestAssured HTTP + direct JDBC)
- ✓ No mocking (@MockBean, mockStatic, @SpringBootTest forbidden)
- ✓ Parallel-safe test data (testId per method, self-contained fixtures)
- ✓ 10 SQL fixture files (idempotent setup/teardown)
- ✓ Shared support class (BlackBoxSupport.java)

**Configuration**:
- ✓ No authentication (endpoints are public)
- ✓ No external dependencies (all internal Service/Repository)
- ✓ MySQL database (post, comment tables)

All artifacts are in `.nimbus/artifacts/manifest.json` (5 endpoints, status=ok). Specs preserved in `.nimbus/specs/*.json` for regeneration if code changes.
